128.label: Pre-grasp Alignment
128.description: Steering with F128 causes the robot to approach target objects but hover above them rather than grasping -- exactly consistent with forcing a pre-grasp feature to remain active.

1902.label: Transport / Goal Proximity
1902.description: Steering with F1902 causes the robot to skip object grasps entirely and move directly to the goal location.

262.label: Memorized Milk
262.description: F262 is a memorized feature tied to milk manipulation. Steering with F262 disrupts the robot's behavior across tasks that do not involve milk, demonstrating task-specific memorization.

1330.label: Memorized Ketchup
1330.description: F1330 is a memorized feature tied to ketchup manipulation. Steering with F1330 disrupts the robot's behavior across tasks that do not involve ketchup, demonstrating task-specific memorization.
